item.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery announce $110 billion deal
item.description: A massive $110 billion merger has been signed between Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance.

item.title: Greater Houston Black Chamber of Commerce working with local businesses to achieve long-term success
item.description: Over its 91-year history, the Greater Houston Black Chamber of Commerce has supported the growth, development, and sustainability of local businesses.

item.title: Montgomery County condensing polling locations for March primary, election administrator says
item.description: Montgomery County election officials said they are working to condense voting locations for Election Day on March 3.

item.title: Taste of Soulful Sounds to round out Black History Month celebrations in Baytown
item.description: From spirituals to soul, jazz, and hip-hop, a local group in Baytown is closing out Black History Month with a powerful celebration of the African American musical journey.

item.title: Man accused of poisoning Southern California couple by spraying bug spray on food
item.description: A couple is speaking out after their roommate allegedly poisoned them, leading to a standoff with deputies. Video shows the man spraying bug spray on their groceries.

item.title: Suspect charged in shooting that left 52-year-old man dead at Willowbrook-area apartment, HPD says
item.description: The suspect, 49-year-old Johna Robinson, was charged with murder in the shooting death of a 52-year-old man on Grant Road, according to HPD.

item.title: Houston's Cinco De Mayo parade canceled this year amid ICE concerns, LULAC says
item.description: The Cinco De Mayo Parade, held annually in downtown Houston, has been canceled this year amid rising concerns of ICE enforcement activity, LULAC said.

item.title: Some question why murder suspect was released from Harris County Jail
item.description: A murder suspect was allowed to walk out of the Harris County Jail hours before or after a murder charge was filed against him, depending on whose account you believe.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
